The '''Witches' War Fan''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] which saw use during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fan, which doubled as a weapon, was commonly used by the [[Witches of Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:WWF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Witches' War Fan appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WWF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Witches' War Fan was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Witches of Dathomir Theme Park|Witches of Dathomir Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:WWF" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 19|Game Update 19]]" on [[December 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="GU19">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1160720|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 19}}</ref>
